subject: Vendor master: confirm legal name + DBA for billing and PO routing

Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding: registration info attached / legal name question

Hi team,

Thanks for starting the vendor registration — I have the packet attached but spotted a discrepancy I want to confirm before we create the vendor master. On the registration form you uploaded the legal name as "VesselCo LLC" but the invoice sample and bank remit say "Vessel Commercial" and the header on your W-9 (if you send it) should reflect the legal entity.

To avoid duplicated master records in our ERP, can you confirm the canonical legal entity name (exact wording, including Inc./LLC/etc.) and whether "Vessel Commercial" is a DBA only? If you have an EIN or a W-9 available, please attach that as well. Also confirm the remit-to bank account last four digits so our AP team can validate the transfer details.

Attached: vendor-registration-form.pdf (filled)

Next steps from our side: once we have the confirmed legal name + tax doc we’ll normalize the vendor master and share the PO routing lane (standard Redwood AP path is "AP-Redwood-Standard"). If there are any special invoicing requirements (PO exceptions, email-based invoices, or remit-to clearinghouse), note them in your reply.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to have this vendor live for PO issuance by next Monday.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0217

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the note — apologies for the confusion. Our legal entity is "VesselCo, Inc." (registered in DE). "Vessel Commercial" is a trading name / DBA that our sales team uses on public-facing invoices for certain accounts. We can accept purchase orders to the legal name "VesselCo, Inc." and will include "Vessel Commercial" as a DBA line if you need it displayed on the invoice.

Attached: W-9.pdf (EIN redacted on shared copy), bank_remit.pdf (remit instructions)

Remit bank account last four digits: 4321
Preferred invoice email: ap@vesselco.com

If you need a signed ACH authorization form or additional tax paperwork, let me know and I’ll route it from legal.

Regards,
